$comment: Batch execution plan for the SIM HAF UAT suite. Batching exists ONLY to respect the application login throttle (5 attempts / minute / email|ip). It does NOT define, remove, or skip approved scenarios: every registered scenario still runs in exactly one batch unless its own test is intentionally deferred. Keep batch selection separate from the approved baseline (baseline/scenarios.json).

loginPolicy.throttle: 5 login POSTs per minute per email+IP (routes/web.php:33 throttle:login)
loginPolicy.note: One executable J-S1/J-S2 test performs ~1 successful login via signIn(); TC-REQ-006 performs 1 failed login. A 4-worker parallel run makes all logins land inside the same 60s window and trips HTTP 429, so batches are serialized (workers=1) and spaced. expectedLogins counts login POSTs (successful AND failed) because the throttle counts both, and deferred tests never reach a login. validate-batches enforces: expectedLogins <= maxLoginsPerBatch < loginAttemptsPerMinutePerIdentity, cooldownSecondsAfterBatch >= 60, workersPerBatch = 1.
